name_zh: 消去相机干扰的形变优化
formal_object: Legal image residual r=r0+J_g delta_g+J_c delta_c in R^m; W positive definite; geometry and camera increments with a fixed gauge.

operations.condition: Allowed image correspondences and an identified gauge
operations.output: Separate nuisance and scientifically relevant directions

operations.condition: Weighted camera Gram rank is checked
Observation nullspaces may remain after elimination

derivation_steps.statement: For fixed delta_g, delta_c*=-(J_c^T W J_c)^dagger J_c^T W(r0+J_g delta_g).
derivation_steps.justification: Weighted least squares in nuisance coordinates.

derivation_steps.statement: P=I-J_c(J_c^T W J_c)^dagger J_c^T W leaves a residual P(r0+J_g delta_g).
Geometry curvature becomes J_g^T W P J_g; WP is symmetric positive semidefinite.
derivation_steps.justification: Weighted projection is self-adjoint in W; use the Schur complement.

assumptions: Input-derived pixel correspondences and camera estimates are required; evaluation ICP transforms and GT camera labels are forbidden inference shortcuts.
A camera gauge and a local linearization region must be specified.
Image fitting alone need not identify depth or material correspondence.
The ordinary benchmark does not automatically license extra camera metadata as inference input.
method_expression: Jointly fit legal input-camera nuisance and shape corrections; use the profiled geometry subproblem and validate the nonlinear residual after each bounded step.
distinguishing_prediction: Geometry updates should avoid chasing residual directions explained by camera; no improvement is expected if those nuisance directions are absent.
falsifier: Reject if ordinary PnP/camera fitting plus an identical geometry solver is adequate or the central claim cannot be tested without GT leakage.
closest_alternative: Classical bundle adjustment/Schur elimination; STAC camera recovery.
decisive_comparison: Qualified input-only PnP plus geometry, joint optimization and profiled optimization under identical inputs/budget; native ActionBench scores remain unchanged.
operational_delta: A profiled geometry metric, not simply camera alignment; benchmark permissions and functional novelty remain unresolved.
feasibility_and_cost: Qualified video-to-mesh correspondences and camera estimation are missing, so reserve rather than presenting runnable geometry fitting.
structural_signature: Weighted elimination of a nuisance parameter block.
algebra_review_basis: Re-derived weighted projection and PSD Schur metric; gauge/rank and allowed-information constraints retained.
empirical_status: Not implemented in this round; no native method comparison or outcome.
originality_status: Unadjudicated. Classical tools and historical related code are explicitly attributed.
